instruction: A lonely 1960s desert gas station at sunset: two rounded fuel pumps under a winged canopy, a small office with a garage bay, a vintage pickup parked beside, a stack of tires, a humming soda vending machine, a rotating sign on a tall pole, cacti and tumbleweed, and long shadows across the cracked concrete under an orange sky.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Desert Retro Gas Station. A lonely 1960s desert gas station at sunset: two rounded fuel pumps under a winged canopy, a small office with a garage bay, a vintage pickup parked beside, a stack of tires, a humming soda vending machine, a rotating sign on a tall pole, cacti and tumbleweed, and long shadows across the cracked concrete under an orange sky. Style: americana sunset. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
